subsystem: Apple Silenus H18ISP Frame State Synchronization (FrmState) & Time Machine Engine
architecture: Zero-Shutter-Lag (ZSL) Circular Frame Descriptor Ring Buffer with Multi-Exposure Bracket Fusion

caller_function.format_string: TM Capture: ch:0x%zu send ch:0x%lx num:%u retain:%u fstype:%u ts:%llu mode:%u bktag:0x%x rqtype:%u

descriptor_fields.name: ch
descriptor_fields.description: Camera Sensor Channel ID (0: Wide, 1: Ultra-Wide, 2: Telephoto)

descriptor_fields.name: send_ch
descriptor_fields.description: Destination channel routing mask for ISP hardware interconnect

descriptor_fields.name: num
descriptor_fields.description: Total number of exposure frames in the Smart HDR bracket burst

descriptor_fields.name: retain
descriptor_fields.description: Circular ring buffer retention depth for temporal/spatial fusion

descriptor_fields.name: fstype
descriptor_fields.description: Frame State configuration type ID binding to aisp_IspStatsPipe*_FrmState

descriptor_fields.name: ts
descriptor_fields.description: Hardware Start-of-Frame (SOF) nanosecond timestamp from MIPI CSI-2 receiver

descriptor_fields.name: mode
descriptor_fields.description: Computational capture mode (0: Preview, 1: Smart HDR, 2: Deep Fusion, 3: Night Mode)

descriptor_fields.name: bktag
descriptor_fields.description: Exposure bracket tag bitmask (0x1: EV0 Nominal, 0x2: EV- SIFR Highlight, 0x4: EV+ Shadow, 0x8: Strobe, 0x10: Synthetic High-Speed)

descriptor_fields.name: rqtype
descriptor_fields.description: Capture request type (0: Live Preview Streaming, 1: Still ZSL Time Machine Capture)

time_machine_raw_buffer_pools.purpose: Dual-Camera Primary Sensor ZSL Rolling Ring Buffer
Front-End Processor (FEP) Intermediate Raw Thumbnail & Feature Buffer
